name: Bhagavad Gita 9.26
text:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
meaning: Whoever offers me with love a leaf, a flower, a fruit or water, that offering of love I accept.
purpose: The value of a sincere offering, however simple.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
